Understanding #HMPV

HMPV or Human Metapneumovirus is a respiratory virus first identified in 2001. It is similar to other viruses like RSV
Transmission
HMPV spreads through respiratory droplets from coughing or sneezing, as well as through close contact with an infected person https://t.co/rNrnbBeidp

nodes.author: tukuyuboe
nodes.text:
Symptoms:
HMPV causes flu-like symptoms including cough, fever, headache and nasal congestion. In severe cases, it can lead to bronchitis or pneumonia, particularly in young children, the elderly and those with weakened immune systems. https://t.co/cT3eb1VooG

nodes.author: tukuyuboe
nodes.text:
According to CDC "Currently, there is no specific antiviral therapy to treat HMPV and no vaccine to prevent HMPV. Medical care is supportive."
